summary: Fed the existing paper_signal_producer with continuous market snapshot input from PANTHEON_SOURCE_INGEST_URL /api/source-ingest/snapshots/latest. Added unit test coverage validating HTTP snapshot retrieval and metadata attachment.

Signal metadata attaches market_input_ref and market_input_observed_at correctly
